name: kela
description: React template with TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, Jest, Lefthook, Playwright, and TailwindCSS

scripts.start: echo '🚀 Starting the app... Please wait.' && pnpm run build && echo '✅ Build complete. Launching the app...' && node dist/src/server.js
scripts.format: echo '🖋️ Formatting code... Please wait.' && prettier --write . && echo '✅ Your code is formatted!'
scripts.lint: echo '🧹 Linting code... Please wait.' && eslint -c eslint.config.ts . && echo '✅ Linting complete. Your code is clean!'
scripts.ci: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.clean: echo '🧽 Cleaning up...' && rm -rf ./node_modules ./dist && rm -f package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml
scripts.docker-clean: echo '🧹 Cleaning up Docker resources...' && docker stop $(docker ps -aq) && docker rm $(docker ps -aq) && docker image prune -af && docker volume prune -f && docker network prune -f && docker builder prune -f
